title: Logarithmic-Space Access Language
statement: For either Boolean mode $m$, the language consisting of pair encodings of Boolean words $z$ and binary representations of natural numbers $r$ for which the access value of $z$ at $r$ in mode $m$ is true is decidable by a deterministic Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of logarithmic space in the input length.
